scope: Select and copy transcript text without opening response actions on click
behavior: Simple response clicks do not open menus
Left-button drag highlights display cells without copying automatically
Ctrl+C copies only the selected visible text; Escape clears the highlight
Whitespace-only selection does not quit or overwrite the clipboard
Ctrl+Y and /actions retain explicit full-response/code/source actions
Unicode graphemes, reverse drags, multiple lines, scroll offsets and releases outside the panel are handled
Reading cells stay stable while selected; new messages are retained and shown after clearing
Resize/session change clears stale selection; Alt+End clears it and resumes following
Terminal and modal controls retain precedence
A missing or failed native clipboard helper falls back to the serialized terminal OSC 52 writer
OSC 52 requests do not claim confirmed receipt; SSH never launches a server clipboard helper
